ecdict.transformation: All nonempty headwords with Chinese definitions; no frequency or exam-tag filtering. Five fields saved in ecdict-core.csv.gz (historical filename retained).

annota-phrases.source: Original short bilingual equivalents authored for Annota. No external dictionary definitions copied.
annota-phrases.scope: Paper reading, attention/ML, mathematics/statistics, common phrases, software and science. Coverage is curated, not exhaustive.
annota-phrases.transformation: Preserve canonical word boundaries; record explicit spelling/inflection aliases; generate concise Chinese reverse equivalents except ellipsis constructions. Original source entries retained.
annota-phrases.review: Build validates unique canonical keys, short meanings, bounded input and category counts. Regression cases cover contextual terms, inflected phrases, line breaks and non-equivalent concatenations.
